title: G70 oxygen sensor faults
summary: The sampled feedback centers on G70 service cases for oxygen monitor and post-catalyst oxygen sensor faults, with several reports describing malfunctions and sensor replacement activity.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe permanent or occasional oxygen monitor sensor malfunctions, fault codes for the post-catalyst oxygen sensor, and service actions including sensor replacement.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined feedback is limited to a fragment referencing a TSARA case and valves without enough detail to confirm the underlying issue or sentiment.

limitations: The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G70 vehicles or all oxygen sensor issues.
Some negative-assigned examples are repair-log or case-management fragments with limited customer-impact detail.
One included negative-assigned fragment concerns a front camera circuit rather than an oxygen sensor topic, so the cluster contains some unrelated service content.
